lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid formation posterior to the gill slits. Centroid distribution shows higher density in the upper lateral region, becoming more dispersed toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible coordinate-like lattice across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a smaller, distinct marine organism with a streamlined silhouette positioned on the dorsal surface of the primary subject.
